title: Remediation: harden or remove the -save logger path-traversal primitive
description: Write-FormattedLog's -save branch (podex.ps1:31-33) writes to ./$($WebEvent.Request.Url.AbsolutePath)/$($WebEvent.Method).json, building the output path directly from the request URL. This is a latent path-traversal / arbitrary-write primitive. The switch is currently never invoked (no caller passes -save), so it is dead code, but it must be removed or hardened before any caller wires it up.
spec:
1. Verify the -save branch in Write-FormattedLog (podex.ps1:31-33) no longer constructs its output path from $WebEvent.Request.Url.AbsolutePath.
2. If -save is retained, verify the destination is a fixed, server-controlled directory (e.g. ./logs) and that any request-derived filename component is sanitized to strip path separators and '..' segments so a request path cannot escape that directory.
3. If -save is not needed, verify the entire -save branch and switch parameter are removed so the arbitrary-write primitive no longer exists.
4. Verify no caller of Write-FormattedLog passes -save with an unsanitized request-derived path (grep the codebase for -save).
notes: Source: CODEBASE_ANALYSIS-2026-07-10.md | Claims: claim-logger-path-traversal (Security section [Low], Recommendation #13) | Verified: 2026-07-10 (latent; -save has no callers) | Not covered by existing audit-codebase-analysis-* features. | RESOLUTION 2026-07-10: chose spec option 3 (remove) since a codebase-wide grep confirmed no caller ever passes -save. Removed the [switch]$save parameter and the entire `if ($save) { $log | Out-File -FilePath "./$($WebEvent.Request.Url.AbsolutePath)/..." }` branch from Write-FormattedLog in podex.ps1, deleting the arbitrary-write primitive outright. All remaining callers pass only -tag/-log. Parse-checked podex.ps1 (OK); npm test 50/0 pass; npm run lint reports only pre-existing vendored-JS errors (ESLint does not lint .ps1).
